model: MBDMX-PLUS (Heavy Duty DMX Mirror Ball Motor)
notes: Amazon listing B0CJLL2Q6H ('MBDMX-Plus', brand Eliminator, item model MBDMX-PLUS, sold by Hollywood DJ) re-read 2026-08-26 confirms the product: heavy duty DMX mirror ball motor for up to a 20 in ball, two 3-prong Edison sockets for pinspots, 2 DMX channels (ch1 lighting on/off, ch2 motor speed and direction), circuit breaker, 3-pin DMX in/out, primary/secondary sync of up to 4 units, 10.5 W @ 5 rpm / 10.2 W @ 0.5 rpm, 8 x 4.8 x 5.75 in, 4 lb (1.8 kg, updated from 2.0), IR cable for the UC IR remote, DIP-switch addressing. Amazon's 'Product Dimensions 9.25 x 8.5 x 5.75 in' is the box. Rear label reads model MBDMX2 (MB DMX II lineage). Not a fog machine: ch1 switches the pinspot sockets, so 'Lamp' is whatever is plugged in; the unit has no light source of its own (optics=null). Power figure is the motor draw only. Repo channel map (ch1 Lamp, ch2 Rotation) matches the listing and manual exactly. No GDTF-share entry located.
